demos.name: PositionedTooltips
demos.source:
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';

export default function PositionedTooltips() {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: 500 }}>
      <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="top-start">
          <Button>top-start</Button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="top">
          <Button>top</Button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="top-end">
          <Button>top-end</Button>
        </Tooltip>
      </Stack>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <Stack direction="column" sx={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
          <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="left-start">
            <Button>left-start</Button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="left">
            <Button>left</Button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="left-end">
            <Button>left-end</Button>
          </Tooltip>
        </Stack>
        <Stack direction="column" sx={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="right-start">
            <Button>right-start</Button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="right">
            <Button>right</Button>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip describeChild title="Add" placement="right-end">
            <Button>right-end</Button>
          </Tooltip>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
      <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <Tooltip title="Add" placement="bottom-start">
          <Button>bottom-start</Button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip title="Add" placement="bottom">
          <Button>bottom</Button>
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip title="Add" placement="bottom-end">
          <Button>bottom-end</Button>
        </Tooltip>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  );
}

demos.name: CustomizedTooltips
demos.description: Here are some examples of customizing the component.

demos.name: ArrowTooltips
demos.description: You can use the arrow prop to give your tooltip an arrow indicating which element it refers to.

demos.name: TooltipOffset
demos.description: To adjust the distance between the tooltip and its anchor, you can use the slotProps prop to modify the offset of the popper.

demos.name: TooltipMargin
demos.description: Alternatively, you can use the slotProps prop to customize the margin of the popper.

demos.name: TriggersTooltips
demos.description: The touch action requires a long press due to the enterTouchDelay prop being set to 700ms by default.

demos.name: ControlledTooltips
demos.description: You can use the open, onOpen and onClose props to control the behavior of the tooltip.

demos.name: VariableWidth
demos.description: The Tooltip wraps long text by default to make it readable.

demos.name: NonInteractiveTooltips
demos.description: Tooltips are interactive by default (to pass WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 1.4.13).

demos.name: DisabledTooltips
demos.description: In order to work with Safari, you need at least one display block or flex item below the tooltip wrapper.

demos.name: TransitionsTooltips
demos.description: Use slots.transition and slotProps.transition to use a different transition.

demos.name: FollowCursorTooltips
demos.description: You can enable the tooltip to follow the cursor by setting followCursor={true}.

demos.name: AnchorElTooltips
demos.description: In the event you need to implement a custom placement, you can use the anchorEl prop: The value of the anchorEl prop can be a reference to a fake DOM element.

demos.name: DelayTooltips
demos.description: On mobile, the tooltip is displayed when the user longpresses the element and hides after a delay of 1500ms.
